description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for capturing and logging RLC (Radio Link Control) protocol data units (PDUs) in a PCAP format within a wireless communication system. It includes class definitions for RLC PCAP writers, context structures for PDUs, constants for RLC modes and types, and factory functions for creating PCAP writer instances.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_pcap
classes.description: Interface for writing RLC PDUs to a file, with methods for flushing, closing, enabling write, and pushing PDUs.

classes.name: ocudu::pcap_rlc_pdu_context
classes.description: Struct holding context information for RLC PDUs, including mode, direction, sequence number length, bearer info, and UE ID.

classes.name: ocudu::null_rlc_pcap
classes.description: Dummy implementation of rlc_pcap for testing purposes, with no actual data handling.

methods.name: ocudu::create_rlc_pcap
methods.description: Factory function to create an RLC PCAP writer for a specified file.

methods.name: ocudu::create_null_rlc_pcap
methods.description: Factory function to create a dummy RLC PCAP writer that performs no operations.
